overall.statement: The confirmed, reproducible blocker is that the Windows ML 2.x provider catalogue returns S_OK with zero entries on this device in every accepted mode and rejects a direct provider lookup, so no EP can be acquired through the official path. Why the catalogue decides that is not observable without ETW/elevation and is therefore UNVERIFIED.

hypotheses.name: SDK / runtime activation
supporting: windowsml 2.5.96 is the documented minimum and is installed
the API binary is byte-identical to the working host's
contradicting: catalog calls return S_OK, so activation succeeded
hypotheses.independent_reproduction: 3 probe runs + preflight in separate processes
hypotheses.negative_control: same binary on gfx1100 returns 4 providers

hypotheses.name: Python projection
contradicting: wheel flat-C API and WinAppSDK 2.3 projection both return 0
the native DLL exports are exercised directly via ctypes
hypotheses.negative_control: gfx1100 wheel returns 4 with the same surface

hypotheses.name: WinRT package identity / bootstrap
supporting: unpackaged processes can be denied some WinRT surfaces
contradicting: 7 bootstrap surfaces in Experiment B all returned 0 with no identity error once bootstrapped
the wheel flat-C path requires no package identity and still returns 0

hypotheses.name: Catalog provider metadata source
supporting: the metadata is an embedded Store/UUP table in the runtime
the runtime references Store InstallControl and DXCore
internal reasons no_store / no_target_package / not_acquirable exist as distinct outcomes
FindProvider returns 0x80070490, i.e. the entry never materialised
contradicting: Store APIs are alive on this host (AppInstallManager OK)
hypotheses.negative_control: same table produces 4 entries on gfx1100
missing_official_information: authoritative inputs to the catalogue filter

hypotheses.name: Microsoft Store targeting / flighting
supporting: public Store products exist but nothing is offered here
contradicting: WebGPU is broadly targeted and is also absent

hypotheses.name: EP MSIX acquisition
contradicting: absence is a consequence of an empty catalogue, not a cause: ensure_ready cannot even be addressed

hypotheses.name: OEM driver compatibility
supporting: AMD documents an Adrenalin minimum that cannot be mapped to this WDDM version
contradicting: DML runs on the same driver
WebGPU's requirement is only DX12 and it is also absent
hypotheses.negative_control: none possible without a driver change

hypotheses.name: gfx1151 device compatibility
supporting: 1.8.65.0 ships custom_kernels_gfx1151.dll and a different gfx1151 host executed it
contradicting: 0x1586 is not on the published unsupported list
hypotheses.note: compatibility is NOT the same question as catalogue delivery

hypotheses.name: DLL ABI / dependency
contradicting: no DLL exists on this host
on the other gfx1151 host the same DLL loaded into ORT 1.25.2 fine

hypotheses.name: GPU kernel / operator support
hypotheses.note: refuted as the cause of the blocker, not as a property: kernels never run because no EP exists here, and the other gfx1151 host executed them successfully
contradicting: the blocker occurs before any kernel runs
